title: Typography as particles
blurb: A paragraph's letters fly apart as particles and come back. The paragraph is never split into spans, so you can still select it, search for it, follow its link and edit it.
question: Can each glyph of a paragraph be drawn separately while the paragraph stays selectable, searchable and editable?

waitsForPerson.why: its checks start when the reader scrolls down to the Live tests section (shared/on-screen.js)
